description: Navigate to the 'Water Cycle' science simulation in GCompris. The goal is to restore the water cycle by activating the red/inactive components. Locate the Science category (test tube icon), then open the 'Water Cycle' activity. Click on the Sun, Cloud, Water Tower, and Water Treatment Plant to activate them (they turn green or start animating). Once the entire system is active and water is flowing, save a screenshot to '~/Documents/active_cycle.png' and create a text file at '~/Documents/water_cycle_status.txt' containing the text: 'Simulation verified: Water cycle is active.'

metadata.expected_text_content: Simulation verified: Water cycle is active.
